description: Six domain research workflows with stable global governance provider IDs.

interface.shortDescription: Six research skills with scientific drawing
interface.longDescription: A single plugin containing six domain skills for general web research, literature auditing, Zotero attachment import, full-text analysis, PDF highlights, Obsidian notes, and scientific drawing. Governance support resolves through stable global provider IDs.
interface.defaultPrompt: Audit the UAV corpus first, then run a strict literature search or direction review.
